rules.label: CVE-2021-41773
rules.title: CGI traversal probe compatible with Apache advisory context
rules.rationale: A CGI URL containing parent-directory traversal and ending at a shell or password-file path is a traversal probe. The Apache advisory supplies compatible vulnerability context, not a unique CVE signature.
limitations: Other CGI traversal weaknesses and broad automated probing can look alike.
Encoded request details, server version, Alias/CGI configuration, payload and successful execution are unverified.
A detector action and HTTP method are fields of the same request, not independent corroboration.

rules.label: CVE-2017-9841
rules.title: PHPUnit eval-stdin endpoint targeting
rules.rationale: The maintainer describes this exposed endpoint and POST attack vector. The endpoint and method support targeting context only; the saved request does not include the PHP payload.
limitations: No vulnerable PHPUnit version, malicious payload, exploit success or named malware/tool/operator is established.
Androxgh0st cannot be attributed from this shared endpoint.
A missing endpoint after path redaction cannot be reconstructed or guessed.
